definitions.explanation: Medical care or procedure given to a patient.
Action taken to deal with a situation or problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応急|おうきゅう}{処置|しょち}→応急処置：06519_oukyuushochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{処置|しょち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}した→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor administered appropriate treatment to the patient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{処置|しょち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{処置|しょち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The damage spread because action was taken too late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きたら→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧{処置|しょち}⟦しなければならない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When a problem arises, you must deal with it immediately.

notes:
{処置|しょち} has two main uses: (1) medical treatment or procedures, and (2) measures taken to handle a problem or situation.

MEDICAL USAGE:
- ⟦{応急|おうきゅう}{処置|しょち}→応急処置：06519_oukyuushochi⟧: first aid, emergency treatment
- {処置|しょち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧: to administer treatment
- ⟦{処置|しょち}{室|しつ}→処置室：noentry⟧: treatment room

USAGE:
- {処置|しょち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take measures
- ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{処置|しょち}: appropriate measures
- {処置|しょち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deal with, to handle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: measure, step (more formal/institutional — used for policy or organizational actions)
- ⟦{対処|たいしょ}→対処：05518_taisho⟧: coping, dealing with (emphasizes responding to a problem)
- ⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: medical treatment (longer-term or more comprehensive than {処置|しょち})
